flashcards.title: Profit more than doubled
flashcards.fact: GTCO reported ₦1.266 trillion in profit before tax for 2024, up 107.8% from ₦609.3 billion in 2023.

flashcards.title: Deposits surged
flashcards.fact: GTCO's deposit liabilities grew 37.8% in 2024, rising from ₦7.55 trillion to ₦10.40 trillion.

flashcards.title: A larger loan book
flashcards.fact: GTCO's net loan book increased 12.3% during 2024, from ₦2.48 trillion to ₦2.79 trillion.

flashcards.title: ₦1 trillion profit milestone
flashcards.fact: Zenith Bank recorded ₦1.033 trillion in profit after tax in 2024, up 53% from ₦676.9 billion in 2023.

flashcards.title: Nearly ₦30 trillion in assets
flashcards.fact: Zenith Bank's total assets reached about ₦29.96 trillion at the end of 2024, 47% higher than a year earlier.

flashcards.title: Deposits passed ₦21 trillion
flashcards.fact: Customer deposits at Zenith Bank rose 45% in 2024 to approximately ₦21.96 trillion.

flashcards.title: More than 80 million subscribers
flashcards.fact: MTN Nigeria says its network connects more than 80.9 million mobile subscribers.

flashcards.title: Nigeria's first 5G operator
flashcards.fact: MTN Nigeria was the first mobile network operator to launch a 5G network in Nigeria.

flashcards.title: A 43,000 km fibre footprint
flashcards.fact: MTN Nigeria reports an expansive fibre network covering more than 43,000 kilometres.
